title: DNA Extraction
author: Klaus J Stark
materials: The tube was inverted to loosen the clot. The blood clot was completely poured with 5 mL RBC Lysis Solution Qiagen into the Clotspin Basket placed on a 50 ml tube
The remaining clot material from the Clotspin basket was transferred through the basket to the filtrate with 00:10:00 RBC Lysis Solution Qiagen and the basket was discarded.

The tube was vortexed rigorously for 00:00:10 and additional 5 mL RBC Lysis Solution Qiagen was added to the pellet, followed by vortexing for 00:00:03 and incubation on a circulating shaker (250 1/min) for 00:05:00 at Room temperature
samples were cooled down On ice for 00:05:00 and 1.7 mL Protein Precipitation Solution Qiagen was added, followed by rigorous vortexing for 00:00:20

2 mL of Cell Lysis Solution Qiagen and 10 µL of Proteinase K (20 mg/ml) Contributed by users were added, followed by incubation at 55 °C for 02:00:00 in a warming cabinet or at Room temperature Overnight on a circulating shaker (250 1/min)
samples were cooled down On ice for 00:05:00 and 1 mL Protein Precipitation Solution Qiagen was added, followed by rigorous vortexing for 00:00:20

steps.title: Warm frozen blood clots
steps.instruction: Transfer frozen blood clots in 15 mL tubes from –20 °C to a warming cabinet set at 55 °C for 10 min, then immediately place the tubes on ice.

steps.title: Centrifuge to disperse clot
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 2000 × g for 5 min (temperature not specified) to disperse the clot.

steps.title: Vortex and shake filtrate
steps.instruction: Vortex the filtrate vigorously for 3 s, then place the tubes on a circulating shaker at 250 rpm for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second vortex and centrifugation
steps.instruction: Vortex the tubes vigorously for 3 s and centrifuge again at 2000 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Discard supernatant, retain pellet
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant, ensuring the pellet remains; if no pellet is visible, retain approximately 0.5 mL of supernatant in the tube.

steps.title: Pellet white blood cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2000 × g for 5 min to pellet DNA‑containing white blood cells.

steps.title: Final supernatant removal and vortex
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant leaving about 0.2 mL residual liquid, then vortex rigorously for 10 s.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL Cell Lysis Solution (Qiagen) and 25 µL Proteinase K (Qiagen, 20 mg/mL) to each tube, and vortex vigorously for 10 s.

steps.title: Overnight lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes overnight at 55 °C to achieve complete lysis of DNA‑containing cells.

steps.title: Post‑lysis centrifugation and ice incubation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysates at 2000 × g for 10 min, then incubate the tubes on ice for 2 min.

steps.title: First isopropanol precipitation (5 mL)
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant to a 50 mL tube containing 5 mL isopropanol, invert the tube gently 50 times, and centrifuge at 2000 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Discard isopropanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant, drain the tube on absorbent paper without losing the pellet, and visually inspect the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Second isopropanol precipitation (3 mL)
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (if a second precipitation is required) to a new tube containing 3 mL isopropanol, invert gently 50 times, and centrifuge at 2000 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Discard second precipitation supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, drain the tube, and keep the pellet intact.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL 70 % (v/v) ethanol to the pellet, invert until the pellet detaches, then centrifuge at 2000 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 5 mL 70 % ethanol, invert until the pellet detaches, centrifuge at 2000 × g for 3 min, discard supernatant, and air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for 10 min or until it appears glassy.

steps.title: Final centrifugation and ice incubation
steps.instruction: After the ethanol washes, centrifuge the tube at 2000 × g for 10 min and incubate on ice for 2 min.

steps.title: Hydrate DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL DNA Hydration Solution (Qiagen) for a large pellet or 0.3 mL for a smaller pellet, incubate at 65 °C in a warming cabinet for 1 h, then place on a shaker overnight at room temperature to fully dissolve the DNA.

steps.title: Collect and store DNA
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the dissolved DNA, transfer the solution to a 2 mL tube, and store at –20 °C.
